explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/507, whose best bounds are log n/n² ≪ α(n) ≪ n^{−7/6+o(1)}. This statement asks for an answer g with log n/n² = o(g) and g ≪ α, i.e. it asserts that the KPS82 lower bound can be strictly improved. The source asks for no such thing, and the docstring ('Estimate a lower bound') does not disclose the presupposition. If α(n) ≍ log n/n² (not ruled out), the statement is false for every choice of answer. So it is an invented sub-question whose truth is not equivalent to the source problem of estimating α(n).
